notes: Solved independently: v = t − 2 changes sign at t = 2 s, so the distance is ∫₀²|t−2|dt + ∫₂⁴(t−2)dt = 2 + 2 = 4 m. I confirmed this by numerical integration of |v| over 0 to 4 s (4.000000) and of v itself (0.000000 net displacement). Both printed definite integrals evaluate correctly: [2t − t²/2]₀² = 4 − 2 = 2 and [t²/2 − 2t]₂⁴ = 0 − (−2) = 2. The distinction between distance and displacement is stated correctly in the approach and carried through the steps. common_mistakes[0] is the net-displacement error giving 0 m, which is not an option and correctly carries option null; common_mistakes[1] gives 2 m, which is option 1 as stated.
